idea-plugin.name: Orbital
idea-plugin.description:
Orbital — a visual client for Azure Cosmos DB

Orbital is a visual client for Azure Cosmos DB (SQL / Core API) inside PyCharm and other JetBrains IDEs. Browse and manage your account, run queries, and edit documents and server-side scripts without leaving the IDE.

  • Manage multiple account connections (keys are stored in the IDE PasswordSafe, not in plain text).
  • Tree explorer: account → databases → containers → stored procedures / triggers / UDFs.
  • Create / delete databases and containers; view throughput and properties.
  • Run SQL with paging; results in a sortable table; see the request charge (RU) per page.
  • View, create, edit (upsert) and delete documents as JSON, with partition-key handling.

Connect with an Account URI + key, or paste a full connection string.

Disclaimer: Orbital is an independent, third-party product. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Microsoft. "Azure" and "Azure Cosmos DB" are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies.
